name: Magnetic Signs
headline: Magnetic Vehicle Signs for Flexible Promotion
shortDescription: Removable magnetic vehicle signs for contractors, mobile services, and temporary business branding.
body: Magnetic signs let a vehicle carry business branding when needed and return to regular use afterward.
They are useful for contractors, service vehicles, and businesses that need flexible vehicle identification without permanent lettering.
capabilities: Passenger car and pickup truck formats
